elements.label: Browser viewport and tab strip: Jira Product Discovery idea view replaced by a Medium article (uxdesign.cc) via a blank white loading frame
elements.change_other: hard swap through a one-to-two-frame white flash (browser tab switch / page load)
elements.text: Templates increase user engagement and productivity

pattern.description: The screen recording switches from the Jira Product Discovery tab to a second browser tab showing an external article; the viewport goes white for about a frame while the page paints, then the article appears fully formed. Lands on 'or better again' after 'dropping a link'.
pattern.why_premium: Shows the real source of an insight (an external article) in the same browser chrome, so the cut reads as the user's own workflow rather than an edit; timed to the narration pivot so the context switch feels motivated.

build_hint.gsap: Faithful replica: tl.set(jiraView, {autoAlpha: 0}).set(whiteFlash, {autoAlpha: 1}).set(articleView, {autoAlpha: 1}, '+=0.033').set(whiteFlash, {autoAlpha: 0}); plus tl.set(tabA, {className: 'tab'}).set(tabB, {className: 'tab active'}, 0). Polished alternative: gsap.fromTo(articleView, {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power1.out'}) with no flash.
build_hint.remotion: Sequence switch at the event frame: render <JiraView/> before, a 1-2 frame white <AbsoluteFill/>, then <ArticleView/>; active tab styling switches on the same frame. No spring (step change).

notes: Screen-recording tab switch, not an authored transition; the whole frame changes so all OCR text boxes are part of one swapped page and are not listed individually. Could arguably be logged as a shot-level hard_cut rather than an event. No SFX candidates.
